<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-25. -->
## YouTube Music

- **Light theme (#90):** Choose **Light** in **RVX → General → App theme** and restart. Home, Search, Library, and Settings use light surfaces. Now Playing uses a pale gradient based on the current cover without recoloring artwork or video. Works with solid and glass bars on supported Music versions from 8.12 onward. The default and existing dark presets are unchanged.

## YouTube

- **Account switcher (#91):** Enable **Account switcher shortcut** in **RVX → General → Navigation bar**. On 21.39.525 and 21.45.90, hold **You** to open the native account picker. A tap still opens the tab.
- **Ghost mode (#92):** Watch without sending YouTube’s playback history updates while staying signed in. Enable it under **RVX → General → Ghost mode**. It does not erase existing history or hide all activity from YouTube. Available on 21.13.164, 21.39.525, and 21.45.90.
- **Glass menus (#89):** Opening frosted menus no longer moves the playing picture. The menu uses a snapshot instead of redrawing the live video surface.

This is a patches prerelease. Select the prerelease channel in your existing RVX Manager source, refresh, then repatch and reinstall the app you use. Stable remains on **v1.52.0**.
